_comment: Exact products aggregated per oil (rapeseed & soybean only, UK, reliable sellers, 20L). Prioritises no-login sellers (Booker public listing + open JSON-LD) for automatic daily updates; gated sellers carry forward. Seller products averaged then aggregated across sellers with a 2-SD filter. UK oils zero-rated so inc-VAT = ex-VAT.
